issue.title: Update Settings Menu to Reorganize Account Actions
issue.body: The settings menu already ships with an Add User link and a Switch User section for managing multiple logged-in accounts. Today Add User sits above Privacy Policy and Terms of Use, disconnected from the account list below it. This ticket reorganizes the menu so account actions are grouped together. ## Functional Requirements ### Accounts Section - Rename the "Switch User" section header to "Accounts." - List all logged-in accounts under the header, each showing display name and initials or icon, with a checkmark on the active account. - Move the "Add User" row out of the top settings group and into the Accounts section, as the last row below the listed accounts, using the `li:user-plus` icon. - If three accounts are already logged in, hide the "Add User" row and show the message "You've reached the 3-account limit" in its place, matching the account switcher panel. ### Switch Account - Tapping a non-active account row in this menu makes it the active account immediately and closes the menu. - Reuse the existing switching logic and error handling from #87; do not open the separate account switcher panel from this menu. ### Add Account - Tapping "Add User" launches the same add-account flow used by the account switcher panel's "Add Account" row (see #86). Note: This entry point is additive to the drafting page header indicator (#85), not a replacement; both trigger the same underlying switch/add logic. Note 2: Sign Out remains the last item in the menu, below the Accounts section, and is unaffected by this change.
